subject: Redwood demo: propose 30-min windows & security checklist
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <alopez@helixdata.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 13:15:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood demo: propose 30-min windows & security checklist

Hi Anna — great conversation earlier today, thank you for the time. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- What we heard: HelixData is looking to lower token cost on search reranking pipelines and standardize model serving across dev/prod with predictable latency.
- Success criteria you mentioned: (1) <5% regression on current ranking quality, (2) p99 latency targets <150ms for 1k concurrent requests, (3) clear roadmap for secure private deployments.

Next step: a 30-minute demo to show the runtime, cache/batching behavior, and a short ops/security touchpoint. Can you confirm which of the following works for your team (times shown in PT / ET):

1) Thu Jan 21 — 10:00–10:30 PT (1:00–1:30 ET)
2) Thu Jan 21 — 11:00–11:30 PT (2:00–2:30 ET)
3) Fri Jan 22 — 09:00–09:30 PT (12:00–12:30 ET)

If none work, suggest two slots that do. I’ve cc’d Rishi (AE) for pricing/contract context and Marissa (Customer Success) to join for onboarding questions.

Pre-read / attachments: I’ll attach a short 30-min demo agenda and a one-page security checklist. Please let us know if you want a dedicated security engineer on the call — we can schedule that for the follow-up deep dive.

Thanks — I’ll wait to lock a slot.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-30min-demo-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Security-Checklist-Redwood.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Anna Lopez <alopez@helixdata.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@helixdata.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 09:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood demo: propose 30-min windows & security checklist

Thanks, Irene — nice recap. Rajiv and I reviewed our calendars. Option 2 (Thu Jan 21 11:00 PT / 2:00 ET) works best for us.

Attendees from HelixData: 
- Anna Lopez — Head of Search (me)
- Rajiv Patel — CTO (may hop on for first 10 minutes)
- I’ll invite our infra lead if we think the security checklist warrants deeper discussion.

Two quick asks before the demo: 
1) Can you include a short slide or live demo on how Redwood handles KV/prefix caching for reranking? That’s our main technical concern.
2) For the security checklist, will you be able to share SOC/Security artifacts or a short note on data residency and retention?

If Rishi or Marissa want to add anything, feel free — otherwise we’ll lock Thu Jan 21 11:00 PT.

Best,
Anna
Anna Lopez
Head of Search | HelixData
alopez@helixdata.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <alopez@helixdata.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo: propose 30-min windows & security checklist

Anna — great, locking Thu Jan 21 11:00 PT. I’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and a brief comment on expected pricing bands so you have context before the demo. 

Quick notes against Anna’s asks: 
- KV/prefix caching: Irene will demo the live behavior. During the call we can show a short replay of hit-rate improvement on a sample reranking workload.
- Security artifacts: we can share the SOC2 summary and our data retention controls. For sensitive details (e.g., encryption keys/KMS flow) we typically follow up with an NDA or a private deck.

I attached the 30-min agenda we typically use — it’s focused and leaves time for ops/security Q&A. Marissa will be on the call to cover onboarding timeline and pilot structure.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood-30min-demo-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)

Perfect — calendar invite accepted (I forwarded to our infra lead). Looking forward to the demo tomorrow.

Attendees confirmed: Anna Lopez (Head of Search), Rajiv Patel (CTO, may join), Neha Singh (Infra Lead, invited).

See you 11:00 PT / 2:00 ET.

Thanks,
Anna
